article.headline: Nets and Magic meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Orlando Magic (6-8, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Brooklyn Nets (3-11, 14th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Nets and Magic meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Nets and Magic meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Orlando Magic (6-8, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Brooklyn Nets (3-11, 14th in the Eastern Conference) New York; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Orlando Magic visit the Orlando Magic in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Nets have gone 2-9 against Eastern Conference teams. Brooklyn averages 16.4 turnovers per game and is 2/3 when it turns the ball over less than its opponents. The Magic are 4-5 against Eastern Conference opponents. Orlando allows 112.8 points to opponents while being outscored by 3.4 points per game. The Nets are shooting 44.9% from the field this season, 1.7 percentage points lower than the 46.6% the Magic allow to opponents. The Nets average 109.4 points per game, 9.8 fewer points than the 119.2 the Nets give up. TOP PERFORMERS: Julius Randle is averaging 20.6 points, 5.8 rebounds and 4.6 assists for the Nets. Michael Porter Jr. is averaging 17.6 points and 6.4 rebounds over the last 10 games. Franz Wagner is averaging 24.4 points, 6.9 rebounds and 8.5 assists for the Magic. Desmond Bane is averaging 4.3 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Nets: 3-7, averaging 109.5 points, 40.4 rebounds, 24.5 assists, 7.6 steals and 5.2 blocks per game while shooting 45.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 117.3 points per game. Magic: 5-5, averaging 110.3 points, 43.3 rebounds, 27.0 assists, 7.3 steals and 4.1 blocks per game while shooting 46.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 110.1 points. INJURIES: Nets: None listed. Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: out (knee), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
